For the Petitioner(s) : Mr. N. Islam, Advocate For the Respondent(s) : Mr. P. S. Bhattacharyya, CGC  Mr. A. Bhattacharyya, SC, Revenue  Mr. C. Baruah, Advocate  MR. R. K. Talukdar, Advocate
BEFORE
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE DEVASHIS BARUAH  ORDER 06.04.2026 Heard Mr. N. Islam, the learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners.

Mr. P.
S. Bhattacharyya, the learned CGC Page No.# 6/7 appears on behalf of the Respondent No.1; Mr. A.
Bhattacharyya, the learned counsel appears on behalf of the Respondent No.2; Mr. C. Baruah, the learned counsel appears on behalf of the Respondent No.3 and Mr. R. K. Talukdar, the learned counsel appears on behalf of the Respondent Nos.4 to 6.
2.

The learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners submits that as at present only a Notification has been issued under Section 3A of the National Highways Act 1956 (for short, 'the Act of 1956'), and as such, the petitioners herein would be well advised to approach the concerned authorities seeking determination of compensation in terms with Section 3G(1) of the Act of 1956 read with Section 3G(7) of the said Act of 1956.

The learned counsel for the petitioners therefore submits that the petitioners herein would not like to pursue the instant writ petition without prejudice to the rights of the petitioners to approach the appropriate authority seeking compensation as per law.
3. Taking into account the above, the instant writ petition therefore stands closed on withdrawal.
